paraphrase: The Śūraṅgama ('heroic going') samādhi is attained only by bodhisattvas of the tenth ground; it contains all samādhis, and one abiding in it can display every kind of life — even entering nirvāṇa — without abandoning beings; hearing of it with faith is a cause of awakening.
notes: Reference from the unit author's knowledge at chapter level; passage not read in a local text in this phase.
